verdict.reasons: Core identity, readable branding, product count, and required technical evidence are present with no contradictions or safety defects.

focused_physical_review.reason: The full-frame image displays a single white-and-blue AFP roll sitting directly on the soil surface with visible, uninterrupted earth surrounding its base and sides, confirming a clear_soil_gap. To the right, an installed black lateral line coils around a pressure gauge; this continuous line is not touching or crossing the package, so line_touches_or_crosses_package is false. The observed black coil is the connected lateral of the installed system, not a separate loose product, making extra_loose_product_coil false. Inspection of the carton sides and base in the full frame and detail crops shows no white ribbon, strap, or tape tail emerging from the package, resulting in package_has_protruding_strip being false.
